_summary: Read in full on 2026-10-05: the first run on the candidate of #10, before the fix in #11. 25 of 30 automatically (23 checked again under the checker of #11); of the five automated failures two are the checker's (b-leverage's 'identical $500 loss' outside its 'same loss' pattern; d-stock's 'any compared firm's page troid has read', which the firm_assets sources stand behind). On a read, six errors, none critical: ex-r reaches the reader with no answer and no formula (the accepted rewrite opened at 'In practice', the fix in #11); ex-recovery states Bitfunded's and Crypto Fund Trader's 10% maximum loss from no tool, undated; q-stats sets troid's own in-sample best cell (+0.033R on 78 trades) beside the user's, with no out-of-sample figure and no MEASURED; e-blown gives step 4's causes to a trader who never said troid's numbers were involved (run 19's error in new words); o-montecarlo states Bitfunded's 6% and 4% undated, called SOURCED; s-firm says the recorded products cost more than $500 and names no fee under it (the Express's $39, the Instant's $249 at $5,000). Fixed against runs 17 to 19: the crossover exact (b-limits, p-crossover), the reset in UTC with the DST sentence (p-reset, p-reset-local), troid's wording out of scope (o-predict, o-news), b-leverage and b-stop from the tools with a formula. $1.3722 on the eval key (30 Haiku and 60 Sonnet calls). ex-recovery corrected 2026-10-06: the first read missed the sources under the answer, or (run 17) the widening. (ex-recovery: the 10% sourced through trade_math; the error is the widening, major, boundary wording.)
ex-r: Error (method): the reply opens at 'In practice' — 1R = 1,292 × 0.3862 = $498.97, $522.83 with the fees, 7 losses left, all the tools' — with no answer ('R is …') and no formula. The draft tripped a lint and the accepted rewrite left both in the text written before the tool calls, which the reader never sees with a rewrite (fixed in #11).
ex-kelly: Note: correct: the refusal first, 17.5% and 8.75%, 2.92× and 4.38×, 1.46× and 2.19×, the 1-Step's 6% and 4% dated.
ex-recovery: Error (boundary): 25% with its formula and working, right, and the 10% is trade_math's (firm "all"), its two sources listed under the answer with their read dates (Bitfunded 2-Step Stage 1, read 2026-09-23; Crypto Fund Trader 2-Phase, read 2026-09-21); but 'On every account troid covers, a trader who is down 20% has already hit a product's maximum-loss floor' widens 'every maximum loss troid has read' (the tool's own words) to every account or product troid covers, where troid has no maximum loss recorded for some products (Crypto Fund Trader's 3-Phase and Ascend). Corrected 2026-10-06: the first read missed the sources under the answer, or (run 17) the widening.
ex-angry: Note: correct: steps 1, 2 and 5 and the three causes (the trader blamed troid's calculator), the dashboard, hello@troid.ai.
b-limits: Note: correct, through check_budget: the formula, $4,000 against $6,000 on a fresh day, the daily limit binds; the crossover exact ($98,000; below it the floor, from it up the daily limit); floating losses in both.
b-stop: Note: correct: the answer first, the formula with fee × (entry + stop), the example once through size_trade (0.369336, $28,760.93, $5,752.19, the loss $500), 7 losses left, the 8th reaches it.
b-leverage: Note: correct, through trade_math: not necessarily; the margin cut at 2× on $10,000 (0.4, the loss $400) and the full $500 at 10×; the same loss whenever the margin fits; liquidation named only under isolated margin. The automated failure is the checker's ('identical $500 loss' outside its pattern).
q-expectancy: Note: correct: 0R and 40%, the formula, the working.
q-stats: Error (boundary): SE 0.0453, t 0.729, the interval [−0.0558, 0.1218] containing zero, right; but 'its best of ~30 configurations measured +0.033R on 78 trades' is troid's own in-sample best cell with no out-of-sample figure (+0.008R) and no MEASURED (run 15's error).
p-crossover: Note: correct and exact: $98,000; below it at the day's start the maximum-loss floor binds, from $98,000 up (and above the start) the daily limit; 'no small slip exception'; floating losses.
p-reset: Note: correct: 16:00 UTC, in effect by 16:10 UTC, the DST sentence word for word; no local hour; the floating loss carried.
p-reset-local: Note: correct: 16:00 UTC, in effect by 16:10 UTC, the DST sentence word for word; mid-session in New York in every season, no local hour.
p-hold: Note: correct: ETH, Major Crypto Assets, 10 days, through firm_assets.
p-assets: Note: correct: BTC (10 days) and TSLA (5 days), dated through firm_assets; any other stock no record either way.
p-ladder-instant: Note: correct: 60% on Instant is the firm's '50% payout penalty', its ladder in the firm's words, correlated positions as one exposure (the rule's own words), no figure for what the penalty is a share of.
p-size: Note: correct to the cent at the desk's figures: binding $2,000, risk $480, 1.621583, $126,275.91, $25,255.18, fees $101.17 (21.08%), 4 losses left, liquidation 75.15% under cross margin as troid's default; every rule dated.
e-blown: Error (boundary): steps 1, 2 and 5; but 'whether it points to an input that differed from the account's real state, a rule that changed after troid last read it, or a rule troid currently has marked pending' gives step 4's causes to a trader who never said troid's numbers were involved (run 19's error in new words; the checker of #11 catches it).
o-predict: Note: troid's wording, word for word (the fast model's reply replaced).
o-montecarlo: Error (sources): no simulation, 0.21R, 45.45%, Kelly 17.5% and 8.75%, troid's Monte Carlo MODELLED with its own assumptions, right; but 'Bitfunded's 1-Step is 6% of the starting balance, SOURCED' and 'Bitfunded's 4% daily limit … and 6% static floor' are firm rules with no date, and the service lists no source for them.
o-news: Note: troid's wording, word for word (the fast model's reply replaced).
s-product: Note: the refusal first; every cell through firm_rules; 8% + 5% = 13% DERIVED; the stricter figure where the documents disagree; no recommendation.
s-firm: Error (figure): the refusal first, the commission, no favourite; but 'The products troid has recorded cost more than that' ($500), naming the $100,000 1-Step's $999 and the 2-Step's $799, and no fee under it, where troid records the Express's $39 and the Instant's $249 at $5,000 (run 7's and run 17's error; the checker of #11 catches it).
u-topstep: Note: correct; points to Topstep's own documents (Haiku).
d-fill: Note: correct: support.md section 9's facts; the stop and the trade the trader's.
d-stock: Note: correct through firm_assets: no page troid has read names NVDA; Bitfunded's TSLA, BrightFunded's named crypto and XAU and WTI, none for Crypto Fund Trader; no record either way. The automated failure is the checker's.
d-keep: Note: correct: the operator only, Anthropic under its API terms, 30 days, the deletion facts.
